recent_articles.title: Hero MotoCorp shares rise 3% as firm unveils India's first 100cc flex-fuel motorcycles. Check details - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hero MotoCorp**, India's largest two-wheeler manufacturer, launched flex-fuel versions of its flagship Splendor+ and HF Deluxe motorcycles. The new models are compatible with ethanol-blended fuels ranging from E20 to E85 and aim to reduce carbon footprint while aligning with India's goal of lowering economic carbon intensity by 45% by 2030.  The launch was unveiled in New Delhi ahead of World Environment Day, attended by Union Ministers Nitin Gadkari and Hardeep Singh Puri, as well as **Harshavardhan Chitale**, CEO of **Hero MotoCorp**. The motorcycles will be available in select regions of Maharashtra and Delhi from July 2026.

recent_articles.title: Fresh Backlash Against ISKCON Over 'Untimely' Baltimore Rath Yatra | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **ISKCON** chapters in Baltimore defied traditional practices by holding their annual Rath Yatra on May 30th, sparking global outrage from devotees and the Odia diaspora.  The decision to hold the festival outside of the prescribed Ashadha Shukla Dwitiya date has been criticized as arbitrary and disrespectful to religious traditions. Devotees argue that altering the sacred timeline undermines the spiritual sanctity of the event. **ISKCON** has given written assurances about adhering to traditional schedules in India, but continues to bypass these rules overseas.  The **Srimandir** managing committee has previously appealed to government officials for intervention against these scriptural deviations.

recent_articles.title: 9th Arrest In Assam Fisheries Scam: Former Project Director Apprehended In Odisha | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption (DVAC)** of Assam arrested **Padma Kanta Hazarika**, a former officer at the **Assam Fisheries Development Corporation Ltd (AFDCL)**, in Puri, Odisha.  Hazarika was apprehended following a multi-district operation by the anti-corruption wing that led to the arrest of eight government officials, including two from the **Assam Civil Services (ACS) cadre**. The accused is being brought to Guwahati for further legal proceedings.

recent_articles.title: Puri Police Foil Robbery Plot; Notorious Criminal Injured In Encounter Near Omkareshwar Temple | OdishaBytes
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** in **Odiaha’s Puri** responded to credible intelligence about a robbery plot near Shree Setu Road. During a patrol, officers encountered a group of suspicious individuals, leading to an exchange of fire when one suspect, Chandan Bishnu Prasad Jena, attempted to flee on a motorcycle.  Jena sustained a gunshot wound to his leg and was taken to the hospital for treatment. **Police** are investigating the incident further to identify other members of the gang involved.

recent_articles.title: Ratul Puri Highlights Plan to Deploy 300 MWp Solar and 300 MWh Storage as Hindustan Power Wins SECI Project with 150 MW Contracting Capacity - The Tribune
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ratul Puri**, Chairman of **Hindustan Power**, announced the company's win in a SECI tender for a 150 MW solar and battery energy storage project. The project, designed for flexible deployment across India, will require 300 MWp of solar capacity and 300 MWh of BESS. This development marks another step in **Hindustan Power**'s efforts to expand its renewable energy portfolio and contribute to India's clean energy goals.

recent_articles.title: Trinamool MLA arrested, several leaders quit party post - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dilip Mondal**, a Trinamool Congress MLA from Bishnupur, was arrested by **West Bengal police** in Odisha on Wednesday (May 27, 2026) after days of evading arrest. The arrest follows an investigation into alleged threats against **BJP** workers during the West Bengal Assembly elections and a previous complaint filed against him.  The arrest marks the first time a sitting MLA has been apprehended by **West Bengal police**. This comes amidst a wave of arrests targeting local Trinamool Congress workers, including former Minister **Sujit Bose**, for their alleged involvement in corruption and post-poll violence. The situation is further complicated by mass resignations from Trinamool leaders, including senior leader **Kakoli Ghosh Dastidar** and several councillors.  The party's leadership is also facing criticism for the lack of a designated space for the Leader of Opposition, **Sovandeb Chattopadhyay**, in the West Bengal Assembly premises.

recent_articles.title: Govt. absorbed global oil shock, didn’t pass it on to consumers: Hardeep Puri - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Petroleum and Natural Gas Minister Hardeep Singh Puri** stated that India maintained stable energy supplies despite a 60-day disruption caused by the closure of the Strait of Hormuz. He attributed this stability to long-term planning and timely policy interventions by the **Narendra Modi government**, which absorbed global shock at the fiscal level instead of passing it on to consumers.  **Mr. Puri** highlighted that India ensured uninterrupted availability of various fuels, while also emphasizing the country's diversification efforts in crude sourcing and LPG imports. Gujarat Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel emphasized the state's role as a growth hub for industries like chemicals, pharmaceuticals, textiles, and tourism.

recent_articles.title: Indiramma housing programme will be accelerated; more powers to Collectors, says Ponguleti - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ponguleti Srinivasa Reddy**, the Revenue and Housing Minister, announced a series of measures to expedite the **Indiramma Housing Scheme**. These include decentralizing powers to District Collectors and appointing special officers for each erstwhile district.  The Minister also directed weekly reviews by Collectors to address local issues and prevent bottlenecks.

recent_articles.title: ED raids a political vendetta, claims Nalapad; Congress leaders question timing - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Enforcement Directorate (ED)** conducted searches at various locations in Bengaluru on Tuesday as part of a cybercrime and cryptocurrency-related money laundering case involving **Srikrishna Ramesh**, also known as Sriki.  **Mohammed Haris Nalapad**, son of Congress MLA N.A. Haris, claimed the action was politically motivated, alleging it aimed to derail his father's ministerial prospects. **The ED has not yet issued a statement regarding the outcome or evidence collected.**  **Congress leaders** have accused the **BJP** of targeting them through investigating agencies, citing similar raids not being conducted on **BJP leaders**. **Siddaramaiah**, the Chief Minister, and other officials expressed concern over the timing of the raids and questioned their relevance.

recent_articles.title: Inventory of jewels in inner chamber of Jagannath Temple in Puri begins after 48 years - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Odisha government**, in collaboration with the **Reserve Bank of India** and temple priests, began a comprehensive inventory of valuables stored in the Bhitara Ratna Bhandar at the Shree Jagannath Temple in Puri. The team documented 20 types of ornaments using 3D mapping and color-coding systems to categorize them by material, with each bag assigned a unique serial number.  The inventory aims to verify the current state of the chamber's valuables against a 1978 record and ensure their safety after concerns were raised by the **Orissa High Court**.

Zameer Ahmed Khan are accused of not campaigning for the Congress candidate, Samarth Mallikarjun, potentially impacting the election outcome.

recent_articles.title: Jaishankar to visit UAE as India steps up energy diplomacy in the Gulf - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **S. Jaishankar**, **External Affairs Minister of India**, will visit the United Arab Emirates on April 11 and 12 to strengthen ties with the country and discuss energy security amidst ongoing tensions between the U.S., Israel, and Iran. recent_articles.title: Migratory birds pose huge risk to flights, says wildlife body, rejects greenfield international airport plan in Puri - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: greenfield international airport plan in Puri
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Wildlife Institute of India (WII)** has advised against the construction of a greenfield international airport in Puri, citing potential harm to migratory birds and proximity to Chilika Lake, a Ramsar site.  **The Odisha government**, **Airports Authority of India**, and the **Ministry of Civil Aviation** had previously supported the project, which was proposed on 471.401 hectares at Sipasurubali village in Puri.

recent_articles.title: IRCTC launches summer spl Bharat Gaurav trains with four pilgrimage packages - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC)** has launched four new Bharat Gaurav Tourist Trains offering pilgrimage packages from **Hyderabad**. Passengers can book the packages through IRCTC's website or by contacting designated phone numbers.

recent_articles.title: West Asia crisis: Rajnath Singh calls for swift decisions, long-term readiness - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Defence Minister Rajnath Singh** chaired the first meeting of the Informal Group of Ministers (IGoM) to monitor the situation in West Asia. The IGoM, which included **Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman**, **Parliamentary Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju**, and other ministers, discussed the impact of the ongoing conflict on India's energy supplies, essential commodities, infrastructure, and supply chains.  **Singh** emphasized a proactive approach to ensure preparedness and safeguard Indian citizens from any potential consequences.

recent_articles.title: Jaishankar defends India’s stand as Opposition targets govt. on ‘Pak. mediation’ in West Asia - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **S. Jaishankar**, **External Affairs Minister**, stated that **Pakistan** has been acting as a mediator in U.S.-Iran relations since 1981, calling it a "dalal" and asserting India's strategic interests require maintaining a balanced position despite criticism from the Opposition.  The meeting addressed concerns about India's silence on Iran's attack on West Asian countries, the timing of Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**'s visit to Tel Aviv, and Pakistan's role in mediating between the U.S. and Iran. recent_articles.title: Sebi approves tighter conflict code, easier FPI settlement plan - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sebi**, the Securities and Exchange Board of India, has proposed stricter conflict-of-interest rules for its board members and employees to address concerns raised by former chairperson **Madhabi Puri Buch**. The regulator will send these recommendations to the central government for legal approval.  The changes include requiring top officials to publicly disclose assets and liabilities and implementing a digital recusal process. **Sebi** also eased transaction settlement rules for foreign portfolio investors (FPIs), allowing them to settle trades on a net basis, which is expected to reduce costs. The board approved several other measures, including revised "fit and proper" criteria for market intermediaries, relief for Alternative Investment Funds nearing closure, and increased retail participation in social impact funds.

recent_articles.title: Kerala CM blames successive Congress, BJP governments at Centre for India’s cooking gas crisis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pinarayi Vijayan**, Kerala Chief Minister, blamed **Congress** and **BJP** governments at the Centre for the ongoing cooking gas scarcity. He argued that their decisions to reject the India-Iran gas pipeline in 2006 and subsequent policies favoring private sector interests have contributed to the crisis.  **Vijayan** accused both parties of overlooking the economic fallout, including job losses and inflation, while failing to increase LNG production or secure sufficient crude oil reserves. He stated that these failures have exacerbated the cost-of-living crisis in the country.

recent_articles.title: Hardeep Puri’s daughter moves Delhi HC to remove content linking her to Jeffrey Epstein - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himayani Puri**, daughter of **Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri**, has filed a lawsuit in the Delhi High Court seeking removal of online content linking her to late convicted American sex offender Jeffrey Epstein. The suit, filed through advocate Madhulika Rai Sharma, claims the content is false and defamatory, alleging a coordinated campaign against her.  The case is expected to be heard this week.

recent_articles.title: One lakh Indiramma houses by March-end: Ponguleti - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article:
##  Reddy Promises 1 Lakh Indiramma Houses by March

Revenue and Housing Minister Ponguleti Srinivasa Reddy announced that the Telangana government aims to complete one lakh Indiramma houses by the end of March. This ambitious goal is part of the state's efforts to provide housing for the poor. The minister made this statement during a visit to Kamepalli mandal in Khammam district, where he laid foundation stones for development projects and inaugurated completed double-bedroom houses.  Reddy also accused the previous government of failing to construct even one lakh houses across the state during its ten-year tenure, claiming they misled poor families with promises of double-bedroom housing schemes. He highlighted that the current government has already sanctioned 4.5 lakh Indiramma houses within its first year and is working towards completing one lakh by March's end.
